description: Add YOLOv8-pose for posture/skeleton detection. Add a PoseDetector class that uses yolov8s-pose.pt to extract keypoints. Integrate keypoints into tracking (add keypoints to Detection/Track), enhance play_detector tackle detection with posture analysis, and optionally render simplified skeletons on FieldView.
steps: 1. Create backend/src/cv/pose_detector.py: Implement PoseDetector class following YOLODetector pattern. It uses yolov8s-pose.pt, returns PoseDetection dataclass (extends Detection with keypoints: list of (x, y, confidence) for 17 COCO keypoints). Include method detect_poses(frame) that returns list of PoseDetection. The keypoints array follows COCO format: nose, left_eye, right_eye, left_ear, right_ear, left_shoulder, right_shoulder, left_elbow, right_elbow, left_wrist, right_wrist, left_hip, right_hip, left_knee, right_knee, left_ankle, right_ankle.
2. Update backend/src/cv/detector.py: Add optional 'keypoints' field to the Detection dataclass (default None, type Optional[list[tuple[float, float, float]]]).
3. Update backend/src/cv/tracker.py: Add optional 'keypoints' field to the Track dataclass (default None). In MultiObjectTracker.update(), propagate keypoints from Detection to Track when matched.

4. Update backend/src/cv/video_processor.py: Add optional pose_detector parameter to VideoProcessor. In _process_single_frame, if pose_detector is set, run pose detection on the frame and merge keypoints into existing detections by matching bounding boxes via IoU. Store keypoints in the Track for downstream consumers.

5. Update backend/src/cv/play_detector.py: Add posture-based tackle enhancement. Add a method _is_tackle_posture(keypoints) that checks if the player's torso angle (shoulder-hip line) indicates a low/diving posture (angle > 45 degrees from vertical). In _detect_tackles, if keypoints are available in route points, boost tackle confidence when posture confirms it.

6. Update backend/src/api/routes/video.py: In process_video(), after creating the main detector, also create a PoseDetector if the request includes 'enable_pose' (new optional boolean field in ProcessRequest, default False). Pass it to VideoProcessor.

7. In frontend/src/types/index.ts: Add 'keypoints' optional field to RoutePoint type (type: {x: number, y: number, confidence: number}[] | undefined). Add 'enable_pose' to types used in process requests.
8. In frontend/src/stores/settingsStore.ts: Add 'enablePose' boolean state (default: false) and 'setEnablePose' action.
9. In frontend/src/components/Settings.tsx: Add a toggle for 'Pose Detection (Skeleton)' under the model selection, with description 'Enables posture detection for better tackle/play analysis'.

10. In frontend/src/components/FieldView.tsx: When keypoints are available and enablePose is true, render simplified skeleton lines (shoulders-hips-knees connections) scaled to field coordinates near each player circle. Use thin white lines with 0.4 opacity.
11. In frontend/src/services/api.ts: In startProcessing(), include enable_pose from settings store.

12. Add backend/tests/unit/test_pose_detector.py: Unit tests mocking the YOLO pose model. Test that keypoints are extracted correctly, that the PoseDetector can be instantiated, and that detect_poses returns PoseDetection objects.
acceptance_criteria: PoseDetector class exists and can detect poses with keypoints
Detection and Track dataclasses support optional keypoints
VideoProcessor integrates pose detection when enabled
PlayDetector uses posture data to enhance tackle detection
Frontend Settings has toggle for pose detection
FieldView renders simplified skeletons when enabled and data available
Backend tests pass including new test_pose_detector.py
verification: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/unit/test_pose_detector.py -v
cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v
findings: All 275 backend tests pass. Frontend builds successfully. PoseDetection extends Detection via dataclass inheritance. IoU matching threshold of 0.3 used for merging pose keypoints into main detections. Tackle posture detection uses 45-degree torso angle threshold.
